Mira (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — we're proposing an incompatible change to the Partner SDK surface that will remove the legacy /api/v1/model endpoints and replace them with a unified /api/v2/infer path. This affects marketplace connector packages and a subset of SI integrations. Need to lock a deprecation + migration plan before we ship.
Alex (Eng): Can you spell out the exact break? Is this just path renaming or payload changes too?
Mira (Partnerships): Mostly path + response envelope normalization (we'll standardize on {data: {outputs: [...]}}). Auth remains the same. There are a handful of partners using raw v1 paths in their marketplace installers.
Sam (Platform): If it’s just envelope + path, we can add a 6-week compatibility shim on the router that proxies /api/v1 -> /api/v2 with warnings. Cost: small perf hit and extra code.
Jing (SRE): That shim buys us time but we need canary rollout and feature-flagging. We'll want a kill-switch in case we see error spike.
Luis (Marketplace): Marketplace partners will want a formal deprecation notice and migration checklist. Can we produce a compatibility matrix: which connectors will break, recommended client patch, and an automated smoke test they can run?
Mira (Partnerships): Yes — plan I'm thinking: 1) Announce deprecation (T=0) 2) Publish migration guide + test script (T+2 days) 3) Enable shim/proxy default-on for 6 weeks (T+7 days -> T+49 days) 4) Turn on strict v2 in beta for partners who opt in (T+21) 5) Remove shim (T+56) 6) Final notice and full removal (T+63).
Alex (Eng): Sounds doable. We need to add telemetry: a counter of v1 requests by partner id, and a warning header X-Deprecation-Notice on proxied responses. That helps outreach.
Mira (Partnerships): Exactly. Outreach: we'll email marketplace partners, put a banner in partner console, and add a note to the marketplace listing. Luis, can you coordinate the listing copy + email templates?
Luis (Marketplace): Yep. I'll draft the email and listing note. We should include a one-click update for marketplace-installed connectors if possible.
Sam (Platform): For the shim: sample proxy rule (will circulate in infra channel):
```
# nginx-like pseudo-rule
location /api/v1/ {
  proxy_pass http://inference.internal/api/v2/;
  proxy_set_header X-Deprecation-Notice "v1 removed, use /api/v2 - see /docs/partners";
}
```
Mira (Partnerships): Nice. Also need a partner-facing code snippet (curl) showing how to validate migration: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/v2/infer 
  -d '{"inputs": ["hello"]}'
```
Alex (Eng): We'll add automated smoke tests in CI that hit both /v1 and /v2 for a subset of partner IDs and fail PRs that introduce regressions.
Jing (SRE): Rollout plan needs paging policy: on >2% error increase for v1 proxied traffic, auto-disable proxy and page infra.
Mira (Partnerships): Action items: - Alex: add telemetry + header (owner) - Sam: implement shim + kill-switch + canary (owner) - Luis: partner comms + listing copy - Me (Mira): write migration guide and test scripts, coordinate partner outreach.
Alex (Eng): On it. ETA for telemetry PR: EOD Tue.
Sam (Platform): Will schedule canary next Wed and share runbook.
Luis (Marketplace): Draft email by Mon, will share for review.
partner-bot: Deploy pipeline: Inference-proxy/shim -> staging succeeded (build 0.6.3). :rocket:
Mira (Partnerships): Thanks all — let's reconvene after Sam's canary results. If anyone has partner-specific concerns (esp large SI integrations), ping me directly. :party-blob:
